mapper.insert: INSERT INTO snaps (user_id, snap_title, coord_image, product_image, category, style, color, price) VALUES (#{user_id}, #{snap_title}, #{coord_image}, #{product_image}, #{category}, #{style}, #{color}, #{price})
mapper.update:
UPDATE snaps
snap_title = #{snap_title}, category = #{category}, style = #{style}, color = #{color}, price = #{price},
coord_image = #{coord_image},
product_image = #{product_image},
WHERE snap_id = #{snap_id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM snaps ORDER BY snap_id DESC LIMIT 6
SELECT * FROM snaps ORDER BY like_count DESC, view_count DESC LIMIT 4
